title: Radiant
html:
For other possible meanings of Radiant in the game, see:  Radiant (disambiguation)

⁠Radiant is one of the damage types in the game.

  • For all sources of Radiant, see Category:Sources of Radiant damage.
  • For creatures weak to Radiant, see Category:Vulnerable to Radiant.
  • For creatures resistant to Radiant, see Category:Resistant to Radiant.
  • For creatures immune to Radiant, see Category:Immune to Radiant.

Sources of Radiant damage

The following sections list various ways in which a player character, or creatures they summon, can deal Radiant damage.

Special actions, spells, etc. that are exclusively accessible to non-player characters are not listed.

Spells

  •  Blinding Smite
  •  Branding Smite
  •  Branding Smite (Melee)
  •  Branding Smite (Ranged)
  •  Crusader's Mantle
  •  Destructive Wave
  •  Destructive Wave: Radiant
  •  Flame Strike
  •  Guiding Bolt
  •  Luminous Arrow
  •  Moonbeam
  •  Move Moonbeam
  •  Recast Sunbeam
  •  Sacred Flame
  •  Spirit Guardians (Radiant)
  •  Star Map: Guiding Bolt
  •  Sunbeam

Class actions

  •  Dazzling Breath
  •  Divine Smite
  •  Holy Rebuke
  •  Radiance of the Dawn

Class features

  •  Divine Strike: Radiant: Deal + 1d8⁠⁠Radiant on a melee or ranged weapon attack.
  •  Manifestation of Soul: Unarmed attacks deal + 1d4 + Wisdom Modifier⁠⁠Radiant.
  •  Destroy Undead: Deal 4d6⁠⁠Radiant to creatures affected by  Turn Undead.

Special actions

  •  Blinding Ambush (melee)
  •  Blinding Ambush (ranged)
  •  Bolt of Celestial Light
  •  Dawnburst Strike
  •  Dazzling Ray
  •  Divine Retaliation
  •  Divine Strike: Radiant
  •  Divine Strike: Radiant (Melee)
  •  Divine Strike: Radiant (Ranged)
  •  Recast Dazzling Ray
  •  Strike of the Guardian

Weapons

The following weapons deal Radiant damage as part of their regular attacks.

  •  Deva Mace - inaccessible
  •  Devotee's Mace
  •  Hammer of the Just
  •  Moonlight Glaive
  •  Pelorsun Blade
  •  Shining Staver-of-Skulls
  •  The Sacred Star

Equipment

The following equipment add Radiant damage to the wearer's attacks or can deal Radiant damage through other means.

  •  Callous Glow Ring: Deal +2⁠⁠Radiant to illuminated (non-obscured) creatures.
  •  Holy Lance Helm: Deal 1d4⁠⁠Radiant to any attacker who misses.  DEX Save (DC 14) to negate.
  •  Moon Devotion Robe: While affected by  Mage Armour, a successful save deals 1d4⁠⁠Radiant to the attacker.
  •  Seraphic Pugilist Gloves: Unarmed attacks deal +1d4⁠⁠Radiant.
  •  The Oak Father's Embrace: Deal +1d6⁠⁠Radiant to undead.

Consumables

The following consumable items can be used to deal Radiant damage. In the case of arrows, the damage is in addition to the attacker's regular ranged weapon damage.

  •  Holy Water: Deal 3d6⁠⁠Radiant to fiends and undead in an area.  DEX Save (DC 13) to halve damage.

Interactions

  •  Gloves of Belligerent Skies: When dealing ⁠Thunder, ⁠Lightning or ⁠Radiant damage, inflict  Reverberation.
  •  Luminous Armour: Upon dealing radiant damage, cause a  Radiant Shockwave.
  •  Luminous Gloves: When dealing radiant damage, inflict  Radiating Orb.
  •  The Oak Father's Embrace: Any beast attacking the wearer deals +1d6⁠⁠Radiant.
